messages:
devon: Heads up — reprod something scary during a smoke test. A service account from tenant `tenant-b` could list projects in `tenant-a` after the recent RBAC mapping change. Not production data exfil but def a boundary leak. :(

maria_p: omg. can you drop the exact request/response?

devon: yeah pasted below. token belongs to svc-tenant-b. call to /v1/projects returned 3 projects from tenant-a.

devon: ```
GET /api/v1/projects?owner=org-a Authorization: Bearer svc-tenant-b-token
200 OK
[ {"id":"proj-123","org":"org-a"}, {"id":"proj-456","org":"org-a"}, ... ]
```

aj: pinging eng-sre to see if there's any routing/cache weirdness. @sam_security can you take lead on triage?

sam_security: taking. first-pass hypothesis: workspace->org mapping lookup fell back to a global cache key after the RBAC refactor (the code path that computes `effective_org` got a nil and we defaulted).

lia_policy: that matches a unit test I glanced at yesterday — refactor introduced a helper `resolve_org` that returns `Optional` and callers didn't handle empty. I'll grab the PR.

devon: PR is #4221 (rbac/mapping-refactor). Shows the new helper.

sam_security: immediate mitigation: revoke the service token and rotate keys for affected orgs and disable project listing endpoint for non-admin until patch. Can we do a fast feature-flag rollback?

aj: we have a canary flag. I can flip `rbac:resolve_org_v2` to off in prod-config for all regions. Doing it now.

deploy-bot: config-change applied by aj at 2090123520 — feature-flag rbac:resolve_org_v2=false (target: global)

sam_security: nice. next: validate audit logs to scope blast radius. @audit-bot can you dump recent authz checks for calls to /api/v1/projects in the last 30m?

audit-bot: ```
time=2026-05-12T14:12:08Z principal=svc-tenant-b action=ListProjects resource=org-a/proj-123 result=allow reason="resolved_org=org-a via fallback_cache"
time=2026-05-12T14:12:09Z principal=svc-tenant-b action=ListProjects resource=org-a/proj-456 result=allow reason="resolved_org=org-a via fallback_cache"
```

maria_p: looks like only two or three calls from that principal in the window. no write ops. Good but still a breach of isolation.

sam_security: tracking remediation steps: 1) feature-flag rollback (done) 2) rotate token(s) for svc-tenant-b (in progress) 3) hotfix patch to handle empty resolve_org and add explicit deny-by-default 4) add e2e test for orphaned mapping case 5) postmortem + notify legal if scope expands.

devon: I pushed a hotfix branch that checks `if (!resolved_org) return deny;` and adds a log line `org_resolve_reason=none`. PR #4229. can someone review quick?

lia_policy: reviewing now. small nit: make sure to instrument the cache key derivation with a hash so we can detect collisions.

aj: code LGTM, approving. rolling to staging.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: rbac-hotfix/#4229 to staging at 2090123605

deploy-bot: deploy success: rbac-hotfix/#4229 to staging at 2090123622

devon: validated in staging: same token now gets 403 for project list.

sam_security: schedule for prod deploy in 15m after smoke run. also adding a short-lived WAF rule to block that principal from listing until we patch in prod.

aj: prod deploy started at 2090123690 (rolling).

deploy-bot: deploy success: rbac-hotfix/#4229 to prod at 2090123760

devon: verified in prod: svc-tenant-b token now returns 403 for org-a projects. audit shows `deny`.

audit-bot: ```
time=2026-05-12T14:16:40Z principal=svc-tenant-b action=ListProjects resource=org-a/proj-123 result=deny reason="resolved_org=none -> deny-by-default"
```

maria_p: thanks all. next steps: postmortem draft, add unit+e2e tests, add cache-key collision alert in telemetry, and update RBAC PR checklist to include nil-handling smoke test.

sam_security: I'll own the postmortem. filing incident report and will loop in legal and CISO team per policy.

devon: reopened a quick ticket to audit KMS decrypt calls — we saw no decrypts for tenant-a keys but want to be safe. ticket: SEC-8713.

lia_policy: propose adding an integration test that runs worst-case mapping nils and asserts deny and audit entries. I'll add to the CI pipeline.

sam_security: good. closing this Slack thread; tracking in SEC-8713 and SEC-8714 (postmortem). :thumbsup:
